Planning a trip to Hunza? Save this itinerary.
Luxury and mountains are a rare combination but not anymore, thanks to @pearl_continental_attabad

Here's exactly how we'd spend 3 perfect days in Hunza—from boating on the turquoise Attabad Lake and exploring Karimabad to ziplining near Hussaini Bridge, swimming in Borith Lake, and chasing the most incredible views of the Passu Cones.

And the best part? Coming back every evening to the comfort of Pearl Continental Attabad Lake, the first ever 5 star hotel in Gilgit-Baltistan. Exceptional service, incredible food, cozy rooms and views that make you want to stay just one more night.

If comfort matters as much as adventure, this is the stay I'd recommend every single time.
